dialog.english:
��������That's... whoa, an iceberg!
We're gonna crash,
we're gonna craaaaaash!
dialog.translation:
Eso es... uah, un iceberg!
Vamos a chocar,
vamos a chocaaaaar!

dialog.english: Whoaaaaaaaaa!
dialog.translation: Uaaaaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Owwww. Agumon, are you okay?
dialog.translation: Au... Agumon, estás bien?

dialog.english:
Yeah. The snow cushioned me,
but...
dialog.translation:
Si, la nieve lo ha acolchado,
pero..

dialog.english:
I-it's coooold! We're gonna
freeze.
dialog.translation:
H-hace frio! Nos vamos a
congelar.

dialog.english:
I've got an idea! Want me to warm
you up, Tai?
dialog.translation:
Tengo una idea, quieres que te dé
calor, Tai?

dialog.english:
Oh! You mean with your Llama Bebé!
Okay, but be careful.
dialog.translation:
Ah! Dices con tu Llama Bebé!
Vale, pero ten cuidado.

dialog.english: Got it! Llama Bebé!
dialog.translation: Vale! Llama Bebé!

dialog.english: Hot, hot! Hoooooooot!
dialog.translation: Ah! Quema! Quema!

dialog.english: Agh, I overdid it! Sorry, Tai!
dialog.translation: Uy, me he pasado! Lo siento, Tai!

dialog.english:
I wonder where we're headed...
I don't know about anything but
the island.
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto a dónde vamos...
No conozco nada que no sea la
isla.

dialog.english:
Devimon said something
about beyond the sea...
dialog.translation:
Devimon dijo algo acerca de
un continente...

dialog.english: Where did everyone go...?
dialog.translation: Donde están todos...?

dialog.english: Yuuuuukidaaaarumoooooooon!
dialog.translation: Friiiigiiiimooooon!

dialog.english:
It's Frigimon! He's being
controlled by a black gear!
dialog.translation:
Es Frigimon! Lo controla una
rueda negra!

dialog.english: Huh... Why was I rampaging?
dialog.translation: Por qué estaba iracundo?

dialog.english:
We did it! We destroyed the black
gear!
dialog.translation:
Lo hicimos! Destruimos la rueda
negra!

dialog.english:
You're not hurt, are you? I saw a
kid like you and a Gabumon fall
over there.
dialog.translation:
Estás bien, verdad? Vi a un niño
como tu y un Gabumon caer por
aquí.

dialog.english: Is Matt on that island?!
dialog.translation: Está Matt en esa isla?!

dialog.english:
But how are we gonna get there? I
can't swim...
dialog.translation:
Pero cómo llegaremos allí? No
puedo nadar...

dialog.english:
Well, as my way of thanking you,
I'll help you get there!
dialog.translation:
Bueno, como agradecimiento, te
ayudaré a llegar!

dialog.english: Can you do that?
dialog.translation: Podrías?

dialog.english:
Yeah. I'll freeze the sea to make
an ice bridge to the next island.
dialog.translation:
Claro. Congelaré el mar para
hacer un puente gélido hacia la
isla.

dialog.english:
I see! With a bridge, we can just
walk there!
dialog.translation:
Entiendo! Con un puente podríamos
andar!

dialog.english: So? Should we go?
dialog.translation: Vamos, entonces?

dialog.english:
It's not like we have anything
left to do here...
dialog.translation:
No es que tengamos nada mejor
que hacer...

dialog.english: Let's explore a bit more first.
dialog.translation: Exploremos algo más antes.

dialog.english: All right! Let's go look for Matt!
dialog.translation: Vale! Vayamos a buscar a Matt!

dialog.english:
Got it. I'll be waiting here, so
call me when you're ready.
dialog.translation:
Vale. Estaré esperando aquí,
avisa cuando estés preparado.

dialog.english: Thanks, Frigimon!
dialog.translation: Gracias, Frigimon!

dialog.english: Okay! Let's go!
dialog.translation: Vale, Vamos!
